headline: Binance Secures $6.5 Billion Court Order to Recover Stolen Crypto Assets
summary: Crypto exchange Binance obtained a $6.5 billion worldwide freezing order from the Abu Dhabi Global Market Courts. The measure aims to track and recover assets stolen in an October security breach.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, operating under legal oversight across multiple financial jurisdictions.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: The court order enables global asset tracing to mitigate loss from security exploits.
